reviews.title: Stretchy and sturdy
reviews.body: I was impressed with these PartyWoo balloons!I have purchased a lot of different balloon arch kits with varying degrees of quality.  These were awesome.I purchased black (y18), yellow (y55), and red (y75) which is more of a burgundy or wine red (exactly what I wanted). The product photos showing comparison colors with respective number ID side by side really helped me decide on the shade of red to order!I made a large arch and two balloon columns for the large mylar number balloons.  I assembled everything 5 days before the party and only two balloons deflated ahead of time. I think it may have been my error tying those ones though because they were some of the first balloons that I tied.  The rest lasted for a week and a half until I finally popped them all.The Partywoo balloons were thick and very stretchy and flexible making them super easy to tie.  These blow up evenly where some other brands have balloons are formed oddly and don't inflate to a uniform shape. PartyWoo balloons were very consistent in shape and texture.They looked bright and shiny the day I blew them up but oxidized within a few days before the party. It was most noticeable on the black balloons.Truly I was impressed with the quality.  I also was really impressed at the quantity of balloons included in this set. Because I bought three full sets I had plenty of quantity to make pretty much any design I wanted, but I opted to mix mostly black and yellow sets with a little red accent. Had I just used one set I am certain I could have made a really cool arch as well. I had a lot of balloons leftover though I used more of the black than anything.I do a lot of balloon decorating for my family's birthday parties and other events I host. I will absolutely order PartyWoo balloons again and recommend them to my friends as well. I love that there are so many different colors to choose from.

reviews.title: High-quality balloons with a professional look
reviews.body: I used the PartyWoo Gold Balloon Arch Kit (paired with silver balloons) for an event, and I was really impressed with the overall quality. The balloons looked polished and professional once assembled—perfect for celebrations where you want a more elevated look.The balloons were thick and durable, with minimal popping during inflation and setup, which is always a concern with larger kits. They inflated easily with a standard balloon pump, making the process quick and straightforward. The variety of sizes helped create a full, well-balanced arch.Overall, this kit delivered exactly what I was hoping for: great quality, easy setup, and a beautiful final result. I would confidently use these again for future events.

reviews.title: Let PartyWoo be your go-to for all balloons decor!
reviews.body: I got the dark navy blue z90 colour and the gold balloons and white balloons to make a big balloon garland and a couple of balloon pillars for my son’s school last day of school fair well assembly. They were amazing quality and the colours were rich and beautiful! I will definitely be buying balloons from PartyWoo again! I bought 2 packs of the blue, and wish I bought more of the gold and white to make more pillars but now I know for next time! I was very happy and pleased with the quality and colour of the balloons!

features: 140 PCS METALLIC GOLD BALLOONS DIFFERENT SIZES: Package includes 18 inch balloons (5 pcs), 12 inch balloons (30 pcs), 10 inch balloons (40 pcs), 5 inch balloons (65 pcs)
NON-TOXIC & SAFE: Made of latex, safe and non-toxic, recommended to use with a balloon hand pump or electric balloon pump
WHAT TO FILL WITH: Latex balloons filled with AIR will stay full for up to 72 hours, while with HELIUM will stay full for 3-6 hours. For best float results, fill helium 1-2 hours before your event

MULTIPLE APPLICATIONS: Ideal balloons for balloon garland and balloon arch as birthday decorations, party decorations, wedding decorations, baby shower decorations, anniversary decorations, themed party decorations

ATTENTION & WARNING: Please DO NOT overfill the balloons and also avoid sunburn, overheat, pointed object and excessive friction. Control the amount of air inflated into each balloon to achieve your ideal balloon size
